assessments.reasoning: Four contiguous parts cover all 54,604 bytes of the SPDX detail record, SHA-256 62adea4adb955aa8c8e5a0cecd463bc1e35c8bc906a892a30dd1bb05442cb7cd. Part 1 has isDeprecatedLicenseId=false and the draft notice in licenseText. Part 2 has the exact ID and both publisher citations.

The spdx/license-list-data GitHub API object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0 and gives target type commit and SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. GitHub reports the tag is unsigned. The evidence supports the repository’s tag mapping.

The exact cited URL yielded the NC-SA 1.0 Generic heading and capture SHA-256 06106db3563ce6916149098c0bb82f2fc1ac1b5001974f6f86e0e5a854a87c64. This identifies the citation target. SPDX controls the identifier.

The publisher’s opening fine print expressly refers to distribution of “THIS DRAFT LICENSE.” SPDX repeats the wording in licenseText and marks the block optional in its matching template. Repetition supplies no independent determination of finality and changes neither cited field.

challenge.method: Applied SCES §§3, 4 and 7 by comparing the tag’s target to the JSON locator and both URL fields to the capture. Tested a BY-SA substitution, a later edition and replacement of the cited URL by its canonical link.
challenge.results: The identifier and both citation fields retain NC, SA and 1.0. The generated name uses “Non Commercial Share Alike” and the plain-text heading omits “Generic.” The publisher heading uses “NonCommercial-ShareAlike 1.0 Generic.” These differences leave the literal citation intact. Neither /legalcode.en nor the linked 4.0 edition is the string SPDX cites.

limitations: The crosswalk covers the literal identifier and citation in this release. SPDX’s generated name, plain text, matching template and HTML are distinct representations. Their wording does not establish translation, text equivalence or rights in any project file.

The publisher capture is a live observation. Byte equality with the declared /legalcode.en canonical URL, document finality and legal effect remain unresolved. Index maintenance and consumer release authorization are separate decisions.
reasoning: The SPDX 3.29.0 generated detail record lists CC-BY-NC-SA-1.0. Its crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0] both give https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/1.0/legalcode, exactly the URL of the inspected Creative Commons page.
